candidate_turn_contract.input_source: Phase 6 candidate-safe `report.candidateFeedback.turnBreakdowns[]` delivered through the existing report API and `buildReportViewModel`.
candidate_turn_contract.field: Published framework display name. Render directly; do not infer it from question wording or technical keywords.

Published framework summary and dimensions. Phase 6 must publish candidate-facing `scorePercent` on the framework and each applicable dimension. New dimensions may also carry `level`, `reason`, `status`, and optional server-calculated summary/version fields; `weight`/`earnedPoints` remain backend scoring fields and are not candidate UI display fields.

Published voice-only assessment. `eligible=true` permits display of direct `seconds`, optional published level/percentage if the Phase 6 candidate contract supplies them, and `reason`; missing, false, text-mode, or unreliable evidence stays not applicable/neutral. Do not expose duration points by default.
Candidate-safe feedback text. Render as supplied; never replace it with a client-generated score explanation.

display_contract.new_report: For each applicable dimension show its label, direct server-published `scorePercent` as the primary candidate score, optional published Level `1/5` through `5/5`, and the published reason. Do not show `earnedPoints` or `weight` in the candidate UI.
display_contract.duration_display: Show the duration row only when `durationAssessment.eligible === true` and the candidate-safe fields are present. Display direct seconds and optional published duration score only; do not show a penalty for missing or ineligible duration.
display_contract.legacy_report: If direct percentage is absent, preserve readable direct legacy framework/status/score fields at their original scale where they already exist, or show a neutral unavailable state. Never convert legacy 0-10 scores to percentage or synthesize new dimensions, weights, levels or points.
display_contract.not_applicable: Do not render dimensions marked `not_applicable` as scored component rows. Keep the answer and safe feedback readable.
display_contract.long_reason: Allow existing HTML/TXT/PDF wrapping to show the published reason without changing, summarising, or truncating its semantic content.

coaching_contract.authoritative_source: Phase 6 must publish the 90-120 guidance as a candidate-safe `candidateFeedback.improvementPriorities` item; this is the only coaching field that Phase 7 treats as the cross-surface authoritative contract. `coachingAdvice` remains an optional non-timing UI field unless Phase 6 explicitly allowlists it and the owner expands the export contract.
coaching_contract.surface_precedence: HTML, PDF and TXT must read the same `buildReportViewModel(...).improvementPriorities` precedence for the published priority section. TXT may not bypass the view model and read a different fallback path.
coaching_contract.fallback_policy: Frontend fallback is only for missing legacy payloads and may provide non-timing general coaching. The same fallback priority result must be used by HTML, PDF and TXT; it must not derive duration advice from question count, word count, average duration, or overlong counters.
coaching_contract.timing_language: 90-120 seconds may appear only inside the published `improvementPriorities` contract. The renderer must not invent an independent threshold or claim that a 100-second answer is too long.

no_client_rescoring_contract.rule: Do not multiply level by weight, multiply a 0-10 score by 10, average dimensions, convert legacy scores into new levels or percentage, create a normalized score, or select a main gap from raw client data.

Only Phase 6 server-published `scorePercent` may be rendered as a candidate percentage. Existing server-calculated numeric fields may be displayed as legacy direct values at their original scale, but the client must not reinterpret them as the Phase 7 contract.

data_flow.step: Existing report API returns the Phase 6 candidate-safe report projection; no new API or persistence write is introduced.

`buildReportViewModel` keeps candidate-provided `improvementPriorities` and turnBreakdowns authoritative; only missing legacy coaching may use the cleaned fallback, and all three candidate surfaces consume the same priority result.
`ReportPage` passes `viewModel.turnBreakdowns` to `TurnBreakdownSection`, which renders direct framework/duration fields and preserves answer/feedback state.
`useReportData.handleExport('txt')` passes the same report data to frontend `formatReportAsText`, then `downloadReportFile` creates the Blob; no score calculation occurs.
`useReportData.handleExport('pdf')` passes the same report data to `generateReportPDF`; the PDF builder uses the same view model and direct field display helpers.
Any missing, legacy, text-mode, or ineligible duration state remains neutral on every candidate-visible surface; it never becomes a candidate zero.
